question.problem: Given that the continuous random variable $X$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[0, 10\right],$ compute $P\left(X \leq 7\right).$
question.worked_solution:
The probability density function for a uniformly distributed continuous random variable $X$ on an interval $[a,b]$ is given by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128799/assets/e76831e0e537ad6fdd429115b56034f54f9071574430c41fb9fe5b4888a72b48.svg)

Our random variable $X$ is uniformly distributed on the interval $\left[0, 10\right],$ so it has the following probability density function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14128799/assets/7a7bfa98d0a54a198c0050e763a2f1ac75bca751063b9ea20ec6979163049c6f.svg)

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 7) & =P(0\le X\le 7) \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{7}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{7}\frac{1}{10}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{7-0}{10} \\  & =\frac{7}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
